headword: {知識階級|ちしきかいきゅう}

definitions.explanation: The social stratum composed of educated people engaged in intellectual or cultural work, such as academics, writers, and thinkers. May carry a slightly elitist connotation.

examples.japanese: {知識階級|ちしきかいきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交|か}わす→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧。
examples.english: People from the intellectual class exchange arguments.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明治時代|めいじじだい}→明治時代：28080_meijijidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{知識階級|ちしきかいきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{台頭|たいとう}→台頭：07595_taitou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{著|いちじる}しかった→著しい：10421_ichijirushii⟧。
examples.english: In the Meiji era, the rise of the intellectual class was notable.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{知識階級|ちしきかいきゅう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{一般市民|いっぱんしみん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|しょう}じる→生じる：02118_shoujiru⟧⟦{溝|みぞ}→溝：09410_mizo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}いている→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: That novel depicts the gap that arises between the intellectual class and ordinary citizens.
